ES module builds, copied from npm. The only changes are the wheel-gestures import path in
embla-carousel-wheel-gestures, `__DEV__ = false` in place of process.env (which browsers lack),
and removing the source map comments.

- embla-carousel 8.6.0 (MIT, David Jerleke)
- embla-carousel-wheel-gestures 8.1.0 (MIT, Felix Leupold)
- wheel-gestures 2.3.0 (MIT, Felix Leupold)

The license text that came with them is in LICENSES.txt.
